newsitem.title: TURKEY: Stewart & Stevenson wins Turk plant tender.
newsitem.headline: Stewart & Stevenson wins Turk plant tender.

text.p: U.S. power firm Stewart & Stevenson Services has won a tender in Turkey to build a 32-MegaWatt (MW) power plant in the western city of Izmir for $18 million, Turkish officials said on Friday.

Cemal Dirin, a senior official of Izmir's Organised Industrial Site, a priviledged zone for industrial producers, said the naphtha-fired power plant would supply electricity for 495 companies operating in the zone.
"The power capacity of the plant would be raised to 70 MW and later to 105 MW," he told reporters.
He said Stewart & Stevenson would get a U.S. eximbank credit to finance the project.
He said an agreement was signed with British Petroleum to buy naphtha, but did not elaborate on the BP deal.
